items.title: File Widerspruch against parking permit rejection
items.quote: Gegen die Ablehnung können Sie Widerspruch erheben; er muss innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen dieser Bescheid bekannt gegeben wurde, bei der Stadt Musterbüll, Markt 1, 25899 Musterbüll, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift eingehen.
items.computation: Letter dated (posted) Monday 2027-06-14 by Stadt Musterbüll (a city, not a tax office or formal delivery), posted on/after 1 Jan 2025, so deemed delivery = 4th calendar day after posting per § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG/LVwG SH, as the letter itself confirms ('der vierte Tag, nachdem der Bescheid zur Post gegeben wurde'). Jun 14 + 4 days = Friday 2027-06-18; as this is a general authority (not Finanzamt), the delivery day does not move even if it fell on a weekend/holiday (here it is a Friday, so moot). One-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 VwGO analog, one month after Bekanntgabe) starts the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 2027-06-18 + 1 month = 2027-07-18, which is a Sunday. Since this is a Widerspruch deadline, the end moves to the next working day (§ 31 Abs. 3 LVwG SH / § 193 BGB principle): Monday 2027-07-19, which is not a public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein.
